title: Describe motion through reusable position-time evidence
summary: Approved opening unit and graph-reading bridge; origin change is supporting, not a whole lesson

verificationRecords.command: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/motion-observation.test.ts tests/motion-observation-asset.test.ts; npm run typecheck; npm run check:dependency-direction
verificationRecords.notes: Six tests pass: exact endpoint arithmetic, interpolation assumption, reverse, malformed data, alias ownership, runtime issuance and namespaced observation/point selectors; full types pass after test helper repair. Authority and explanation docs name existing shared owners.

Nine tests pass: governed source, exact stops, reverse projection, held prose and fixed-origin invariance. An initial tsx invocation failed because tsx is not installed; the repository native TypeScript runner passes without adding dependencies.

verificationRecords.command: npm run typecheck; npm run check:dependency-direction
verificationRecords.notes: App, Node, tests, Svelte and domain types pass; dependency-direction gate passes with zero retiring exceptions. Final axis-label change is markup/CSS only.

Three Chromium discovery tests pass after annotation anchoring repair and timestamp labels: seven stops, coordinate invariance, animated button and keyboard travel, reverse horizontal gesture, phone containment and reduced-motion endpoints. Human pedagogy and aesthetics remain pending; no cross-browser or production certification claimed.

expectedLearning: Can a motivated motion explanation reuse mathematical truth without competing time or renderer ownership?
allowedWork: Four approved packages in mechanics-motion delivery proposal
disallowedWork: No automatic twelve-lesson implementation or visual promotion before acceptance
